content: {"like":["Values high‑quality audio‑visual transfers and clear subtitles; appreciates insightful commentary and behind‑the‑scenes extras; enjoys strong ensemble performances and concise, engaging storytelling; prefers well‑executed 3D depth and bright outdoor scenes; seeks entertaining, campy or horror elements with strong impact."],"dislike":["Dislikes excessive Blu‑ray re‑releases and low‑quality handheld viewing; rejects poorly executed 3D effects, ghosting, specks, and grainy sections; avoids boring or repetitive storylines and ineffective extras; dislikes content that feels gratuitous or adds no value; is critical of misogynistic brutality and lack of closed captioning."]}
